Buzzing Whack-a-Doodle

Artifact · {4} · Catalog face mana value 4

As this artifact enters, you and an opponent each secretly choose Whack or Doodle. Then those choices are revealed. If the choices match, this artifact has that ability. Otherwise, it has Buzz.

• Whack — {T}: Target player loses 2 life.

• Doodle — {T}: You gain 3 life.

• Buzz — {2}, {T}: Draw a card.
